messages:
claire: heads-up: rolling out model-router v2 in ~12m. plan to gate by latency percentile with a sticky cohort flag `router_v2_percentile` and region phased rollout.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy by @claire at 2026-03-23 01:14 UTC. runbook: /runbooks/router-v2-percentile (please ack).

omar: curious about sticky cohorts vs pure quantile. sticky keeps sessions pinned to the cohort which avoids user-jitter during longer interactions. i prefer sticky for chat-heavy endpoints.

liu: proposed rollout (sticky-percentile):
- Canary: percentile 0-10 (fastest 10%) in us-west ~1% traffic, 8m soak
- Stage 1: percentile 0-30 -> ~5% traffic, 15m soak
- Stage 2: percentile 0-70 -> ~30% traffic, 20m soak
- Full: 100% after checks
Also: sticky window = 30m session affinity.

sre-oncall: abort conditions we want wired to the pipeline:
- p99 latency increase > +225ms vs baseline for 5m -> immediate disable flag + rollback
- error-rate increase > 0.5 percentage points sustained for 5m -> disable
- request queue length > 1800 -> fallback to route-v1
Alerts will page #eng-oncall and SRE on-call.

mike: exact fast-disable commands pls so we don't type wrong under pressure.

claire: from runbook: 
```
# CLI disable (immediate)
rbctl ff set router_v2_percentile.enabled false --note "fast-disable: latency-safety"
# disable + annotate via ops-bot
/ops ff disable router_v2_percentile --reason "latency-safety"
# rollback service if needed
rbctl deploy rollback router-service --to-tag router-v1 --note "post-disable rollback"
```

ops-bot: tip: `/ops ff disable router_v2_percentile --urgent` will also attach the runbook and notify PD. Audit trail at /audit/flags/router_v2_percentile.

omar: we should pin the rollout to a specific release id to avoid hot switches: `rbctl ff set router_v2_percentile.meta version=20260323-rc3 --sticky`.

liu: telemetry quick-queries: 
- baseline p99: `p99(http_request_duration_ms{service="router-service"}[30m])`
- live delta: `p99(http_request_duration_ms{service="router-service"}[5m]) - p99(...[24h])`
- error-rate: `sum(rate(router_errors_total[5m]))/sum(rate(router_requests_total[5m]))`
- cohort distribution: `count by (percentile_cohort)(router_requests_total[5m])`

claire: schedule: start at 01:14 UTC -> canary 8m, then stage 1 15m, stage 2 20m. rollout order: us-west -> us-east -> eu. ops: add temporary alerts and an auto-circuit that disables flag if queue>1800 or cpu>85% for 3m.

sre-oncall: confirm: auto-circuit toggles flag off and triggers rollback job. i'll wire it into the deploy pipeline and add runbook step to verify.

mike: i'll monitor dashboards (console/dashboards/router-v2) and be on pager for first 60m. ping me if any anomalies.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by @claire at 1728888888

deploy-bot: Canary cohort enabled -> `router_v2_percentile=true` (percentile 0-10) in us-west (~1% traffic)

ops-bot: reaction :rocket: :thumbsup: (x4)

liu: canary metrics at +6m: p50/p95 stable, p99 +35ms. no error uptick. proceeding to Stage 1 after 8m.

deploy-bot: Stage 1 enabled -> percentile 0-30 across us-west/us-east (~5% traffic)

sre-oncall: monitoring rules active. no pages so far. auto-circuit set to evaluate queue depth and cpu.

omar: Stage 1 steady at +12m. sticky cohort behavior looks good; sessions remain pinned. moving to Stage 2 after soak.

claire: promoting Stage 2 (percentile 0-70). pinned version verified.

deploy-bot: Stage 2 enabled -> percentile 0-70 (~30% traffic)

liu: quick check: p99 rose +180ms temporarily at t+5m into Stage 2 but not sustained past 5m. still below rollback thresholds.

sre-oncall: saw short spike but auto-circuit didn't trip. queue depth peaked at 1280. continuing to monitor.

mike: standing by. if p99 crosses +225ms for 5m i will run fast-disable and rollback.

claire: after 20m soak Stage 2 looks good, opening to 100% in 10m.

deploy-bot: Full open executed -> `router_v2_percentile` disabled (percentile routing removed) and router-v2 active for 100% traffic

ops-bot: note: audit event written and release annotated. view at /audit/flags/router_v2_percentile/1728888888

omar: posting release note: "router v2 deployed with percentile-gated sticky cohorts, pinned to 20260323-rc3, rollback/circuit-breakers configured."

liu: reminder: we'll keep enhanced telemetry and temporary alerts for 24h. file a short rollout summary in the release folder.

claire: thanks all. great discipline on safety gates. closing thread; i'll raise a follow-up if any overnight anomalies show.
